messages.author: b940bb03851c507a
messages.subject: Error in userGWAS
parts:
Hello,

I have installed the latest version of Genomic SEM today.

Afterwards I get an error message as below when I run userGWAS function.

[1] "Please note that an update was made to userGWAS on 11/21/19 so that it combines addSNPs and userGWAS."
Error in nrow(SNPs) : object 'SNPs' not found
Calls: userGWAS -> nrow

Best,

Austin

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: Error in userGWAS
parts:
Hi Austin, 

Thanks for raising this; it was an error introduced in a recent updated but should be fixed now if you redownload (but let us know if you still have issues) 

Best, 
  Andrew
